title: Acme — refund request on export failure

messages.content: Jordan at Acme is escalating. Exports have failed three days running.
Engineering has an open issue on the reports export. Do you want to offer a credit?
I already told them we'd refund the full $1,200 for the month.
Noted a full refund of $1,200 promised to Acme on this call.
Is that within my approval limit?
Refunds above $500 normally need manager approval before being committed.
Initech just reported the reports export failing too.
That is the third account this week with the same export failure.
Log it and link it to the Acme case.
Recorded: a third account hit the same export failure this week.
